remove.reason: Depends on cobblemon >=1.7.3 <1.8.0 and has no 1.8 build (single release 1.0.0, 2026-04-15). Client-side QoL; safe to drop.
Already .disabled in the base pack; duplicate mod id with Particular Reforged 1.5.5 (particular-1.21.1-Fabric-1.5.5.jar). Drop the file entirely.
Runtime-incompatible with Cobblemon 1.8: datapack reload calls removed GraalShowdownService.getContext() and aborts world load. Published 0.11.7 and current upstream source retain the same call.
remove.impact: Raid battles and generated raid-den structures are unavailable in the 1.8 target.
remove.replacement: None during EXP-000; do not create a custom substitute during compatibility bootstrap.
remove.world_save_risk: HIGH: the mod adds den structures and persistent blocks, so omit it before campaign world construction rather than remove it later.
remove.follow_up: Retest a future release that explicitly adapts to Cobblemon 1.8, or evaluate a maintained alternative in a separate experiment.

remove.reason: Deadlocks a dedicated server when run alongside server-side Distant Horizons. Reproduced upstream with only C2ME and DH installed: the server locks up and crashes after a few minutes of sustained flight, which is exactly how this 8192-block map is surveyed. DH alone does not crash.
remove.evidence: RelativityMC/C2ME-fabric issue 439, closed as not_planned 2025-06-21. C2ME maintainer: 'DH unable to catch up with the chunk loading speed and explodes. It is a long standing issue on their side.'
remove.impact: Loses parallel chunk-generation acceleration. The campaign world is pre-built and exported from WorldPainter, so almost no new chunk generation happens at runtime.
remove.replacement: None. Removed outright rather than server_excluded, so client and server mod sets stay identical.
remove.world_save_risk: NONE: C2ME registers no blocks, biomes or structures. It only changes how chunks are generated, not what they contain.

remove.reason: Pins cobblemon exactly (1.8.0+1.21.1; its newest build, 1.8.1-fabric-1.3.0, pins 1.8.1) and has no Cobblemon 1.8.2 build (Modrinth queried 2026-10-13). Removed for the 1.8.2 move (the owner, 2026-10-13). Only effect: no EXP on an out-of-battle capture; docs/mechanics/LEVEL_CATCHUP.md lists it as one clamped EXP source, nothing depends on it.

add.reason: Level-of-detail rendering so the authored landmarks (the central rift, the northwest range, the southeast volcano) are visible across an 8192-block map without raising server view distance.
add.pin_note: Exact pin, no floating version. DH requires the same major version on client and server; a drifted client is rejected by the server, so version drift is a hard failure rather than a degradation.
add.beta_note: Every 1.21.1 build of DH is on the beta channel. There is no stable release for this Minecraft version.
add.side_note: One jar serves both Fabric and NeoForge and both sides. There is no separate server download. The server component is required: without it a client only sees LOD for terrain it has personally visited.

add.verification: verified via Modrinth API 2026-10-15 (sha512 lookup of the EXP-056 jar)
add.reason: Per-player chests (ADR-007; the owner, 2026-10-14: 'every chest should be attainable per player'). Loot-table containers convert automatically; the sea town's boat barrels by `lootr custom-chest`. World-critical from the first converted container (lootr:lootr_chest, lootr:lootr_barrel).

server_exclude_note: 35 server exclusions: 33 mod ids whose jars declare environment 'client', PlayerXP as a runtime-proven dedicated-server incompatibility, and Krypton as a provisional server exclusion pending an isolated retest after the riding-seat migration. server_exclude_overrides.reason: PlayerXP 1.1.1 invokes Fabric's client-only ItemTooltipCallback from its common main entrypoint and crashes a dedicated server before EULA handling.
server_exclude_overrides.evidence: experiments/EXP-000-cobblemon-1.8-compat/runtime/server/logs/latest.log, 2026-09-09; upstream source commit a4f81324 has the same client imports and no newer 1.21.1 release exists.
server_exclude_overrides.client_value: May retain EXP Share binding tooltip/UI, but usefulness and client/server registry compatibility remain unverified.

server_exclude_overrides.reason: Removing Krypton 0.2.8 from the server restored authoritative mount/player position synchronization, but visual rider detachment persisted until the Cobbleverse 1.7 seat definitions were migrated to Cobblemon 1.8 locators. Keep the tested exclusion provisionally and retest Krypton server-side after broader mount sampling.
server_exclude_overrides.evidence: EXP-009 live test on 2026-09-10: Better Third Person, Not Enough Animations, and client Krypton had no effect; a vanilla boat attached normally; server-only Krypton removal synchronized queried positions; the generated datapack seat migration then produced a user-confirmed pass for Mudsdale and Charizard.
server_exclude_overrides.client_value: Retain on clients: the successful Mudsdale and Charizard test used Krypton 0.2.8 client-side.
